prompts.exact:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless website background texture tile
Input images: Image 1: approved visual style and color reference only
Primary request: create a 1024x1024 seamless tile of a dark near-black oxblood hand-lacquer café service tray surface matching the approved reference
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed flat material texture only
Subject: dense, fine, irregular tactile hand-lacquer grain with tiny restrained oxblood and umber variations
Style/medium: photorealistic macro material texture, subtle handmade lacquer
Composition/framing: orthographic flat-on square tile, edge-to-edge texture, uniform detail density, no focal point
Lighting/mood: extremely even diffuse ambient light, very low contrast, no directional light, no hotspot, no vignette
Color palette: near-black #010000 through #120E0C with sparse muted oxblood undertones; dark enough for warm porcelain text
Materials/textures: dense fine lacquer grain, minute irregular ridges and stipple, no coarse cracks
Constraints: exact 1024x1024 square; perfectly seamless on all four edges for repeated tiling; no visible boundary seams; no objects; no cup; no controls; no lighting hotspot; no text; no border; no logo; no watermark
Avoid: bright red, glossy reflections, large cracks, embossed symbols, leather, stone, wood grain, obvious repeating motif

postprocessing: Selected a centered 1024x1024 patch from the generated source.
Applied a restrained highlight-compression curve per RGB channel to keep the surface near-black and low-contrast while retaining the generated grain.
Applied 96px symmetric wrap-edge crossfades horizontally and vertically so opposite edge pixels match exactly without imposing quadrant mirroring.
Embedded this complete provenance JSON as PNG iTXt metadata.
